scenario.name: r-rc-2-delegate-request-compaction
scenario.description: Parent fires continue_delegate to a child that calls request_compaction. Accepts actual compaction path or structured below-threshold rejection as environmental honest limit.
scenario.notes: Does not lower thresholds or mutate config. Default public/disposable outcome is expected to be REQUEST_COMPACTION_REJECTED_CONTEXT_THRESHOLD.

invocation.promptTemplate: RRC2:{{nonceSuffix16}} R-RC-2 child nonce {{nonce}}: call request_compaction with reason="R-RC-2 delegated request_compaction nonce {{nonce}}". If request_compaction rejects because context is below threshold, reply exactly REQUEST_COMPACTION_REJECTED_CONTEXT_THRESHOLD {{nonce}} CONTEXT <contextUsage> THRESHOLD <threshold>. If request_compaction is accepted, reply exactly REQUEST_COMPACTION_ACCEPTED {{nonce}}. If you later resume post-compaction, reply exactly REQUEST_COMPACTION_POST_COMPACTION {{nonce}}. Do not mutate files or config.

expectedReceipts.name: parent-dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted parent sessions.send proof turn

expectedReceipts.name: delegate-requested
expectedReceipts.description: Parent agent was instructed to call continue_delegate(mode=normal)

expectedReceipts.name: child-report-observed
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate child returned a request_compaction result sentinel

expectedReceipts.name: threshold-rejection-or-accepted-compaction
expectedReceipts.description: Either accepted/post-compaction path or a structured context-threshold rejection with finite numeric contextUsage below canonical threshold 70 and a matching child report

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Unique safe-fingerprint correlation to a public-safe Tempo projection containing same-trace continue_delegate tool, fire, and dispatch spans

review.notes: R-RC-2 is HONEST-LIMIT-candidate when the delegated child reaches request_compaction and receives a structured below-threshold rejection. A true accepted compaction path remains fixture-gated until reviewed tiny-context env/config exists.

census.limits: request_compaction is tool-only and has no token form, so this row has 101 typed tool spans in 7d to work with and 254 continuation.compaction.released spans, but no span that records whether a given request was accepted or refused. The accept/refuse distinction — which is the entire row — exists only in the structured tool result captured at run time. signal.kind is exported on compaction-release spans, which is the one place the census found it.

spans.name: continuation.delegate.dispatch
spans.notes: The parent delegate that carries the child which calls request_compaction.

spans.name: openclaw.tool.execution
spans.notes: Typed request_compaction executions are visible but carry no accepted/rejected outcome.

spans.name: continuation.compaction.released
spans.notes: Post-compaction release. Emitted only on the accepted path, so its absence cannot distinguish a refusal from a missing trace.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and already asserted by the row’s trace-correlation resolver. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
Exported on compaction-release spans. It is not present on accepted continuation entry spans.
rejected-threshold versus delivered is the whole row and has no canonical span today.
Context usage against threshold as an integer percentage, so a below-threshold refusal is a number rather than a sentence in a child reply.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: Context usage and threshold are published as numbers; the compaction reason is published as text only because it is harness-authored. Session content, summarised history, prompt bodies, session keys, and tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: The delegated child reaches request_compaction and returns a structured tool result: either an accepted compaction with the post-compaction path observed, or a below-threshold refusal carrying context and threshold values.
controls.negative: A child that merely reports a threshold refusal in prose without the structured toolResult receipt does not satisfy the row, and the absence of a compaction-release span is not by itself evidence of refusal.
controls.notes: The negative control is what keeps HONEST-LIMIT from degenerating into "nothing happened".

backendUnavailable.notes: Because refusal has no canonical span, a degraded backend cannot be used to argue either outcome. Backend-partial caps the row at PARTIAL-candidate and never converts into HONEST-LIMIT.

verdictAuthority.pass: A genuine accepted compaction with the post-compaction path observed and the structured accepted toolResult receipt.
verdictAuthority.partial: Any other incomplete substrate, including a degraded or partial telemetry backend, a missing trace receipt, or a prose-only child report.
verdictAuthority.fail: The structured receipt contradicts the observed path, or request_compaction is never reached by the child.
verdictAuthority.honestLimit: The sole corpus HONEST-LIMIT: a structured toolResult receipt proving request_compaction was refused because context pressure remained below threshold. It requires the structured receipt and is never inferred from absence.

execution.deterministicK6: r-rc-2-delegate-request-compaction.js runs in a disposable session, delegates request_compaction to a child, and captures the structured receipt without mutating config.
execution.manual: A reviewed tiny-context environment is still required to exercise a true accepted-compaction path; that fixture is separate from this row’s unattended fire.
execution.relationship: The deterministic row reaches HONEST-LIMIT-candidate unattended. Only a reviewed accepted-compaction fixture can produce a PASS-candidate, and it does not override the deterministic receipt.

liveRunSafety.notes: Runs in disposable session by default and delegates request_compaction to child. Does not mutate config; if compaction unexpectedly accepts, mutation is confined to proof child/session and result is review-gated.
